chain.text: The estate farms 18 hectares. 11 hectares are Cabernet Franc. 7 hectares are Chenin Blanc. Soils are clay and flint. Production averages 62,000 bottles a year. The 2024 harvest yielded 48,000 bottles. May hail destroyed about a fifth of the western crop. Certification is organic since 2019. Biodynamic conversion started in 2023. It requires three compliant years. Earliest biodynamic certification is 2026. Export is 41 percent of sales. Main export markets are Belgium and Japan. The Japanese importer requires sulphites below 60 mg/l. In 2022 tank 4 drifted 3 degrees for two days. That batch lost aroma and sold in bulk at an 11,000-euro loss. Controllers are now calibrated before harvest. Tank 4 has a second probe. In 2023, 900 bottles with wrong vintage were recalled. Label proofs now need two signatures. No irrigation is allowed on western plots. A 2021 trial showed irrigation lowered acidity. Harvest dates use sugar
